name: Radscorpion Egg
blurb: Every known world spawn for Radscorpion Eggs, grouped by region. Directions and photos are added by hand.

world_spawns.note: 24 LPI spawn points (all interior — Carleton Mine) roll a 50% chance each per server hop.

creature_drops.note: Radscorpion kills have a 25% chance to drop 1 egg (entry 3, ChanceNone 75). Same rate for Prime radscorpions.

whitespring.note: Whitespring food vendor always stocks 1 radscorpion egg (guaranteed entry in the unique food pool).

consumption.note: Radscorpion Egg is a food consumable. It grants no timed stat buff on its own.
